_doc: Seed goals for the Phase 1 autonomy loop. Materialized into core/state/goals/<id>.json by `annunimas-cli loop seed-goals`. Hand-authored. See spec/agent-state-contract.md §4.1 and docs/plans/PHASE_1_PLAN.md step 2.

goals.title: Keep provider mesh healthy
goals.intent: Detect provider failures within one tick and route around them. Retire any provider failing two consecutive checks; raise alert if no provider is reachable.

goals.title: Report daily JouleWork
goals.intent: At each day boundary, emit a single LedgerEntry summarizing total joules spent, joules per agent, and joules per provider tier. Operator-readable.

goals.title: Maintain knowledge index freshness
goals.intent: Keep the soterion knowledge map and triage registry current. Re-emit any record whose source-of-truth file has changed since last index pass.

goals.title: Compact ledger segments
goals.intent: Roll any ledger segment older than 14 days into the archive. Preserve audit lineage; never rewrite an existing segment in place.

goals.title: Keep the council reachable
goals.intent: Verify each Council seat (Aurelius, Bacon, Sun Tzu) responds to a triad health probe. If any seat is unreachable for two consecutive ticks, escalate to the operator.
